name: Liminal Aero
storyline:
You are trapped in a liminal world with one goal in sight, escape...
Explore Nostalgic and Liminal Environments that were simply never meant to exist.. But keep your goal in mind.

find a way out of this nightmare. Be careful though. You're not entirely alone. There are entities who are after you..
These entities have 1 goal, take you to their paradise. Forever...

Can YOU put an end to this Nightmare, and go back to reality?
summary: Liminal Aero is an indie horror and liminal-focused game, which blends the glossy, optimistic world of Frutiger Aero with the unsettling feeling of Dreamcore...
